items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: And it was on NBC. And it came on after the Johnny Carson show.

ctx.x: Tell us about some of your experiences with studio work on the west coast.

The studio? Well I haven’t done too many shows and things like that. Most of the things I do in the studio on the west coast are recordings. I go in and do recordings, and that’s just like all recordings, we go in and do those and they’re fun and we do it with a lot of different people and things. Actually you know when I first went to California, when I moved out there, I moved out there because Cannonball had a show. And it was a variety show, the same kind of show as Johnny Carson. Did you know that?
